statement.en: From a local law and a list of exchanges a World of the spine is built whose steps balance. Two interleavings of the same courses, every exchange touching a relatum, are carried one to the other by one renumbering of the steps, under which what is read at a step on what its exchange touches agrees.
statement.zh: 由局部律与交换之列构造出脊柱的一个世界，其各步平衡。同一进程的两个交错，每个交换都触及某关系项时，由所有步的一个重编号彼此相带，经此在一步上就其交换所触及者读出的一切都相同。

laws.en: The configuration after the first t exchanges of a list changes across step t by the exchange at t, is the whole list's from its length on, is unchanged up to a list's length by appending, is after a list the rest's from where the list ends, and agrees where the starts agree.
laws.zh: 一列交换的前 t 个之后的构形，跨第 t 步按第 t 个交换改变，从列长起是整列之构形，到列长为止不因追加而变，一列之后是余下者从该列终点出发的构形，起点一致则一致。

laws.en: The world of a local law on whole-number standings, the relata listed, a list and a start: at step t each relatum stands where the first t exchanges leave it, is active where the exchange at t touches it (decided: touchAt), and the move at t has present the listed relata it touches, each taking its fall and giving its rise; nothing is required, needed or drawn.
laws.zh: 整数所立上的局部律、所列关系项、交换之列与起点的世界：在第 t 步每个关系项立于前 t 个交换使它所在之处，被第 t 个交换触及处为活跃（已判定：touchAt），第 t 步之动在场者为它触及的所列关系项，各取其降、给其升；无所求、所需或所汲。

laws.en: With every relatum listed once, every step of the world balances: the standing after the step with what the relatum took is the standing before with what it gave.
laws.zh: 每个关系项恰列一次时，世界每一步都平衡：步后所立加所取，等于步前所立加所给。

laws.en: A relatum's course of standings is its standing after each exchange of its own course, in order. Moving an exchange forward past exchanges sharing no relatum with it keeps every course of standings, so with the relata listed two lists giving every relatum the same own course, and two interleavings of the same courses, give every relatum the same course of standings.
laws.zh: 关系项的一串所立，是它在自身进程的每个交换之后依次所立。把一个交换前移越过与它不共享关系项的交换，保持每串所立；所以关系项列出时，给每个关系项同一自身进程的两列，以及同一进程的两个交错，给每个关系项同一串所立。

laws.en: With the relata listed, the worlds of two lists giving every relatum the same own course stand alike at every step from both lengths on.
laws.zh: 关系项列出时，给每个关系项同一自身进程的两列，其世界从两者长度起每一步所立相同。

laws.en: Two adjacent exchanges sharing no relatum, taken in either order, leave the worlds alike at every step but the one between them; there a relatum the first touches stands, in the world taking it first, where it stands after both in the other, and where it stood before both in the other; one neither touches stands alike.
laws.zh: 两个相邻、不共享关系项的交换，以任一次序取用，世界在它们之间那一步以外每步相同；在那一步，先取第一个交换的世界中，它触及的关系项立于另一世界两者之后所立处，另一世界中则立于两者之前；两者都不触及者相同。

laws.en: A relatum's standing at step t of a list is its standing after the own exchanges the first t exchanges hold (ownCount, standingAfter). So in two interleavings of the same courses, with the relata listed, a relatum stands alike at any two steps, one in each world, at which it has taken equally many of its own exchanges.
laws.zh: 关系项在一列的第 t 步所立，是它在前 t 个交换所含的自身交换之后所立（ownCount、standingAfter）。所以关系项列出时，在同一进程的两个交错中，关系项在任意两步（各在一个世界）所立相同，只要到那时它已取同样多的自身交换。

laws.en: The index map for a relatum sends a step of one list to the least step of the other at which the relatum has taken as many of its own exchanges (firstAt is that least step; ownCount_index); a relatum stands at step t of one world where it stands at the mapped step of the other. Where it takes an exchange at step t of one list, the map sends t + 1 to the step after the one at which it takes the same exchange in the other.
laws.zh: 关系项的索引映射把一列的一步送到另一列中该关系项已取同样多自身交换的最早一步（firstAt 即那最早一步；ownCount_index）；关系项在一个世界第 t 步所立，等于它在另一世界映射所给那一步所立。它在一列第 t 步取一个交换处，映射把 t + 1 送到它在另一列取同一交换那一步之后一步。

laws.en: What is read through a relatum's own steps is the same for every interleaving: for every property of a standing, a relatum has it at some step of one world exactly where at some step of the other, and at every step of one exactly where at every step of the other.
laws.zh: 经关系项自身各步读出者，对每个交错都相同：对所立的每个性质，关系项在一个世界某步具有它，恰当它在另一世界某步具有它；在一个世界每步具有，恰当在另一世界每步具有。

laws.en: Where every exchange of two interleavings of the same courses touches some relatum (Touching), with the relata listed, the lists have one length, and where one has an exchange at step t the other has the same exchange at exactly one step at which every relatum it touches has taken as many of its own exchanges: the k-th taking of an exchange in one is the k-th in the other at every relatum it touches. The renumbering sends t there (read off the first listed relatum the exchange touches; every relatum it touches gives the same step), and for each such relatum its index map sends t + 1 to the step after. It is undone by the renumbering the other way at every step, sends the steps below the length among themselves and fixes every step from the length on, so the two renumberings Reindex the steps (Becoming.Reordering).
laws.zh: 同一进程的两个交错，每个交换都触及某个关系项（Touching）、关系项列出时，两列等长；一列在第 t 步有一个交换处，另一列恰在一步有同一交换，在那一步它所触及的每个关系项已取同样多的自身交换：一个交换在一列中的第 k 次取用，在它所触及的每个关系项处就是在另一列中的第 k 次。重编号把 t 送到那里（按该交换所触及的第一个所列关系项读出；它所触及的每个关系项给出同一步），对每个这样的关系项，其索引映射把 t + 1 送到那之后一步。反向的重编号在每一步都把它还原，它把长度以下的步彼此对应，从长度起每一步不动，所以两个重编号对诸步构成 Reindexes（Becoming.Reordering）。

laws.en: Through the renumbering the worlds agree: a relatum is active at step t of one exactly where it is active at the renumbered step of the other, for every relatum at every step; the step takes the same exchange (the same relata present, each taking and giving the same: Flow.SameExchange); and every relatum the exchange touches stands alike before it and after it. So every relation read at one step on the relata its exchange touches, however many, holds at step t of one world exactly where at the renumbered step of the other; this holds for any states, not only whole-number standings.
laws.zh: 经由重编号，两个世界相同：对每个关系项在每一步，它在一个世界第 t 步活跃，恰当它在另一世界重编号所给之步活跃；该步取同一交换（在场的关系项相同，各取各给相同：Flow.SameExchange）；该交换所触及的每个关系项在其前后所立都相同。所以在一步就其交换所触及诸关系项读出的每个关系，不论读几个，在一个世界第 t 步成立恰当在另一世界重编号所给之步成立；这对任何状态成立，不只是整数所立。

laws.en: The correspondence with Becoming.Reordering: the renumbering keeps the order of exchanges sharing a relatum (Keeps, for the footprint of the touches, in which two exchanges are joined exactly where they touch a relatum in common), and that footprint moves with it. It contains the exchanges exactly where no relatum is touched at a step after one not touching it, the world's activity being taking part in the exchange across a step. The footprint around each step, what the exchange at it or at the next touches, contains them, activity included, but joins every two consecutive exchanges, so the only renumbering of the steps keeping its order fixes every step: Reordering's commutations relate the world of an interleaving to no other interleaving's world, and the relation between them is the renumbering. On the worlds, world_renumber_correspondence gathers the premises of Reordering's converse the renumbering meets: the reindexing (fixing every step from the length on), the kept order, the same exchange at the renumbered step and the moved footprint.
laws.zh: 与 Becoming.Reordering 的对应：重编号保持共享关系项之交换的次序（对触及的足迹为 Keeps；在其中两个交换恰在共同触及某关系项时相连），且该足迹随重编号移动。它恰在没有关系项在一个不触及它的步之后被触及时包含诸交换，因为世界的活跃是参与跨该步的交换。每步周围的足迹（该步或下一步的交换所触及者）包含它们，活跃也在内，但连起每两个相邻的交换，所以保持其次序的步之重编号只有使每一步不动者：Reordering 的交换不把一个交错的世界关联到任何别的交错的世界，二者之间的关系是这个重编号。在世界上，world_renumber_correspondence 汇集重编号所满足的 Reordering 之 converse 的前提：重编（从长度起每一步不动）、所保持的次序、重编号之步取同一交换、随之移动的足迹。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. A local law on whole-number standings for the world (the laws of own steps hold for any states); the relata listed, once where balance is stated; relata told apart for the move. The courses are finite lists.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。世界取整数所立上的局部律（关于自身各步的规律对任何状态成立）；关系项列出，陈述平衡处恰列一次；为动区分关系项。进程是有限列。

hypotheses.en: For the renumbering: every exchange of both lists touches some relatum (Touching), and the relata are listed. Without the first an exchange touching no relatum has no match (Pair.idle_unmatched).
hypotheses.zh: 重编号：两列的每个交换都触及某个关系项（Touching），关系项列出。没有前者，不触及任何关系项的交换无可相配（Pair.idle_unmatched）。

does_not_show.en: A relation read at one step on relata the step's exchange does not touch: what stands together there is the chosen interleaving's, and no renumbering carries it (Pair.apart_differs).
does_not_show.zh: 在一步就该步交换不触及的关系项读出的关系：那里谁与谁共同所立属于所选的交错，没有重编号能带过去（Pair.apart_differs）。

does_not_show.en: A reading of activity as a relatum's state between steps, under which Reordering's commutations could relate two interleavings' worlds; here activity is taking part in the exchange across a step, so the touch footprint contains the exchanges only in the case touch_contains_iff states and the footprint around each step orders every two consecutive steps.
does_not_show.zh: 把活跃读作关系项在两步之间的状态的读法，在其下 Reordering 的交换可以关联两个交错的世界；此处活跃是参与跨一步的交换，所以触及的足迹只在 touch_contains_iff 所述情形包含诸交换，而每步周围的足迹给每两个相邻的步定序。

does_not_show.en: Courses without end; footprints that read relata they do not change; exchanges touching no relatum.
does_not_show.zh: 无尽的进程；读而不改关系项的足迹；不触及任何关系项的交换。

detail.en: Interleavings.Pair.apart_differs: [0, 1] and [1, 0] interleave the same courses of two relata no exchange connects, and the renumbering exchanges their steps; at step 1 of the first world one relatum stands below the other, and at no step of the second does. A relation read at one step on relata the step's exchange does not touch is not the same for every interleaving.
detail.zh: Interleavings.Pair.apart_differs：[0, 1] 与 [1, 0] 交错两个无交换相连之关系项的同一进程，重编号对调其两步；在第一个世界第 1 步一个关系项低于另一个，在第二个世界没有一步如此。在一步就该步交换不触及的关系项读出的关系并非对每个交错都相同。

detail.en: Interleavings.Pair.touch_not_contains: in the world of [0, 1] the footprint of the touches does not contain the exchanges: the relatum true is untouched at step 0 and touched at step 1, so its activity changes across a step not touching it.
detail.zh: Interleavings.Pair.touch_not_contains：在 [0, 1] 的世界中，触及的足迹不包含诸交换：关系项 true 在第 0 步不被触及、在第 1 步被触及，所以其活跃跨一个不触及它的步而改变。

detail.en: Interleavings.Pair.idle_unmatched: [2] and [] give every relatum the same own course, while [2] has at step 0 an exchange touching no relatum that [] has at no step: without Touching there is no renumbering of the steps matching the exchanges.
detail.zh: Interleavings.Pair.idle_unmatched：[2] 与 [] 给每个关系项同一自身进程，而 [2] 在第 0 步有一个不触及任何关系项的交换，[] 在任何一步都没有：没有 Touching 就没有使交换相配的步之重编号。

next_delta.en: Courses without end; activity read as a relatum's state between steps, under which Reordering's commutations could relate interleavings' worlds; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 无尽的进程；把活跃读作关系项在两步之间的状态，在其下 Reordering 的交换可以关联诸交错的世界；独立审查。

correspondence.en: The twentieth review's G10 asked that Interleavings, which reads the step index off the relata's own courses, construct the World, so that one shared index is a reading on the premise card. Reading (the AI's): the spine's World, with its one index, is what an interleaving of the relata's own courses builds; what the interleaving adds beyond the courses moves only where exchanges share no relatum, and there each relatum stands in one world where it stands a step earlier or later in the other. With the index map (R38), what the world says of each relatum, read through its own steps, is the same for every interleaving: the premise card's one shared index (§0, block A) commits, for what is read per relatum, to no more than a choice among interleavings, which moves where on the index a standing falls and not which standings a relatum passes through or in what order. For the necessity target (the deductive necessity of the whole, item 1 of §8.1, and the representation criterion K4) this makes the shared index a reading wherever a law is read through each relatum's own steps; With one renumbering of all the steps (R46), the same holds of every law read at one step on the relata that step's exchange touches, however many: the shared index is a reading for it as well. What remains a commitment of the representation is exactly which relata that no exchange at a step relates stand together there, and Pair.apart_differs shows that this is not carried by any renumbering: it is the choice of interleaving itself, not a gap in the proof. For the necessity target this narrows the index's part of item 1 of §8.1 and of K4 to laws reading, at one step, relata no exchange there relates; and since Reordering's commutations relate no two interleavings' worlds (activity being taking part in the exchange across a step), the renumbering, not a commutation, is the relation between them.
correspondence.zh: 第二十次审查 G10 要求从关系项自身进程读出步指标的 Interleavings 构造世界，使唯一的共同指标在前提卡上成为一个读法。读法（AI 的）：带唯一指标的脊柱世界，是关系项自身进程的一个交错所构造者；交错在进程之外所加者只在交换不共享关系项处移动，且在那里每个关系项在一个世界中立于它在另一世界早一步或晚一步所立处。有了索引映射（R38），世界关于每个关系项所说者，经其自身各步读出，对每个交错都相同：前提卡上唯一的共同指标（§0，A 区）对按关系项读出者而言，只承诺在诸交错中作一选择，这选择移动的是所立落在指标的何处，而非关系项经过哪些所立或按何次序。对必然性目标（整体的演绎必然性，§8.1 第 1 项，及表示判据 K4），这使共同指标在每条经各关系项自身各步读出的规律处成为一个读法；有了所有步的一个重编号（R46），在一步就该步交换所触及诸关系项读出的每条规律，不论读几个，也是如此：共同指标对它也是一个读法。仍为表示之承诺者，恰是在一步上没有交换相关联的关系项谁与谁在那里共同所立，而 Pair.apart_differs 表明没有重编号能带过它：这就是交错的选择本身，不是证明的缺口。对必然性目标，这把 §8.1 第 1 项与 K4 中关于指标的部分收窄为在一步读该处无交换相关联之关系项的规律；又因 Reordering 的交换不关联任何两个交错的世界（活跃是参与跨一步的交换），二者之间的关系是这个重编号，而非交换。

detail.zh: 复用 LocalLaw、ownCourse、run、act_comm、act_agree、split_heads、untouched_of_shares 与 run_of_courses：自身进程及越过不共享关系项之交换的移动。

output.en: Equal own courses reach the same configuration; apart exchanges commute.
output.zh: 自身进程同则构形同；不相交的交换可交换。

input.en: The standings and the end the worlds share, and the adjacent swap.
input.zh: 世界共有的所立与终点，以及相邻对调。

detail.en: Reuses World.of: a World built from a flow and a web.
detail.zh: 复用 World.of：由流与网构造的世界。

output.en: A World of the spine from a flow and a web.

detail.en: Reuses Reordering's Footprinted, Contains, Joined, Keeps, Reindexes and Flow.SameExchange: the renumbering is stated in its terms, and its footprints are read on the world an interleaving builds.
detail.zh: 复用 Reordering 的 Footprinted、Contains、Joined、Keeps、Reindexes 与 Flow.SameExchange：重编号以其术语陈述，其足迹在交错所构造的世界上读出。

output.en: Footprints, the order of joined exchanges, renumberings of a stretch of steps.
output.zh: 足迹、相连交换的次序、一段步的重编号。

input.en: The renumbering as a Reindexes keeping the order of the touch footprint; which footprints contain the interleaving world's exchanges.
input.zh: 重编号作为保持触及足迹之次序的 Reindexes；哪些足迹包含交错之世界的交换。

conditions.en: Every exchange touches a relatum; the relata listed.
conditions.zh: 每个交换都触及某个关系项；关系项列出。

history.en: 20 October 2026, R38 (the open part of R33's G10): three laws added (the standing at a step as the standing after own exchanges, so equal own counts stand alike across interleavings; the index map, its exactness and its matching of each relatum's exchanges; the readings through own steps the same for every interleaving), the general step-by-step relation thus proved directly rather than by composing adjacent swaps; the open part restated as one renumbering of the steps and the correspondence with Reordering's footprint, with its blocker; what the relation gives the necessity target and the premise card added to the correspondence. history.zh: 2026年10月20日，R38（R33 之 G10 的开放部分）：新增三条规律（某步所立即自身交换之后所立，故自身计数相等者在各交错间所立相同；索引映射、其精确性及其对每个关系项之交换的相配；经自身各步的读法对每个交错相同），一般的逐步关系由此直接证明，而非由相邻对调合成；开放部分改述为单一步重编号及与 Reordering 足迹的对应，附其阻碍；对应部分加入此关系给必然性目标与前提卡者。证明绑定（Interleavings.lean）改到核心回执 20261020T070914.793352Z。研究第 233 节。

history.en: 20 October 2026, R46 (the open part R38 left): three laws added (one renumbering of all the steps, matching each taking of an exchange at every relatum it touches, each such relatum's index map one step back, a Reindexes of the steps; activity, the exchange and the standings of what it touches agreeing through it, so every relation read at one step on those relata agrees; the correspondence with Reordering: the touch footprint's order kept, its containment exactly characterized, and the footprint around each step containing the exchanges but leaving only the identity renumbering), the premise Touching, three counterexamples, a dependency on order-of-exchanges-is-the-invariant; the world's activity restated as the decided touch (touchAt), equivalent to the earlier form (world_active_iff); the open parts replaced by what stays open; the correspondence's last sentence rewritten. Proof binding (Interleavings.lean) rebound to core receipt 20261020T101723.692082Z. Study section 252.
history.zh: 2026年10月20日，R46（R38 所留的开放部分）：新增三条规律（所有步的一个重编号，在交换所触及的每个关系项处相配其每次取用，对每个这样的关系项是其索引映射退后一步，对诸步构成 Reindexes；经由它活跃、交换与其所触及者的所立相同，故在一步就这些关系项读出的每个关系相同；与 Reordering 的对应：保持触及足迹的次序，其包含关系被确切刻画，每步周围的足迹包含诸交换却只留下恒等重编号），前提 Touching，三个反例，对 order-of-exchanges-is-the-invariant 的依赖；世界的活跃改述为已判定的触及（touchAt），与先前形式等价（world_active_iff）；开放部分换为仍开放者；对应部分末句改写。证明绑定（Interleavings.lean）改到核心回执 20261020T101723.692082Z。研究第 252 节。
